spans.s: ? Bhuḍhuka, or better Bhudhuka, ed. at Laṅk 〔366.14〕 (vs), but apparently by em.; mss. Pudruka, Buddhaka; Tib. Bhu-dhu-ka (dental dh!); I see no reason to assume domal ḍh, but the true form is very incertain. Seems to be the name of an astronomical work: bhudhuka-jyotiṣādyāni bhaviṣyanti kalau (so read) yuge.
